criteria.title: Covered diagnosis documented
criteria.description: The diagnosis must match a covered indication.
criteria.policyQuote: Moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis is a covered indication when documented by the treating specialist.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Prior therapy documented
criteria.description: Prior conventional therapy and response must be documented.
criteria.policyQuote: The record must document an adequate trial and response to covered conventional therapy unless contraindicated.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Baseline safety laboratory results available
criteria.description: Required baseline laboratory monitoring must be available.
criteria.policyQuote: Baseline complete blood count and liver-function results must be reviewed before therapy.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Tuberculosis screening documented
criteria.description: A current tuberculosis screening result is required.
criteria.policyQuote: A negative tuberculosis screening result must be documented before initiation.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.
